verdict.rationale: RevenueCat ships Rico, a conversational AI assistant for asking plain-language questions about subscription data ('Why did MRR drop in Germany last week?'), plus an official MCP server letting AI assistants manage apps/products/entitlements via natural language instead of the dashboard, and an AI Toolkit for coding agents. This directly satisfies natural-language operation of the product across both analytics and configuration actions. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports confirming Rico or the MCP server work as described in practice.
